cowork-cog 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Allows CellCog agents to code, debug, refactor, and build directly on your local machine via CellCog Desktop.
- Fully autonomous: all commands are auto-approved for agents, no manual approval required.
- Supports co-working workflows for file access, terminal usage, and full development tasks.
- Built-in security: blocks access to sensitive files, redacts credentials, and scopes sessions to project directories.
- Compatible with macOS and Linux. Requires the cellcog skill and CellCog Desktop app.
